# Shirt Check fixture credits

`chest.jpg` is a crop of a public-domain photograph, used only to check that a bare chest is not called "still dressed".
The crop keeps the head and chest and stops at the bottom of the ribcage.

| File | Source | Author | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `chest.jpg` | https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Anterior_view_of_human_male,_retouched.jpg | Mikael Häggström, from a City Studios / KYO life-model sitting, 29 September 2011 | CC0 1.0 (the Commons file is dedicated to the public domain) |

The download was the 960 px wide rendition
(`https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/1/15/Anterior_view_of_human_male%2C_retouched.jpg/960px-Anterior_view_of_human_male%2C_retouched.jpg`,
960 × 1440). The crop is pixels `x 144, y 28, width 672, height 519` of that rendition (`15%` in from each side, from `2%` down to `38%` of the height), saved as JPEG quality 85.

The suited portrait used as the opposite case is `tests/fixtures/faces/a1.jpg` (see that folder's `CREDITS.md`).
